QuestInfo.name: Decline
QuestInfo.0: What are the #p1101000# Knights doing here? #p2152004# said they were all traitors! Talk to #p1101006# to get his side of the story.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1101006# told you the full story from #p1052001#, and gave you Feather Plants on behalf of the #p1101000# Knights to prove his sincerity.

Take the Feather Plants to #p2152004#.
QuestInfo.2: #p2152004# was really peeved when you returned with the Feather Plants. You're not sure why, but it must have something to do with the #p1101000# Knights. She must really hate those guys.
